description: This file contains C source code for interfacing with AT45 DataFlash memory chips on an Atmel AT91 microcontroller. It includes functions for initializing SPI communication, sending commands to DataFlash, reading/writing memory pages, erasing memory, and ensuring the device is ready for operations.

methods.name: void AT91F_SpiInit(void)
methods.description: Initializes the SPI interface and configures necessary GPIO pins for communication with DataFlash devices.

methods.name: void AT91F_SpiEnable(int cs)
methods.description: Enables the specified chip select (CS) line to initialize communication with a particular DataFlash device.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashSendCommand(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char OpCode,unsigned int CmdSize,unsigned int DataflashAddress)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a generic command to the DataFlash device, with specified opcode and address.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashGetStatus(AT91PS_DataflashDesc pDesc)
methods.description: Retrieves the status register from the DataFlash device.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashWaitReady(AT91PS_DataflashDesc pDataFlashDesc,unsigned int timeout)
methods.description: Polls the DataFlash status register until the device indicates it is ready for the next operation or timeout occurs.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashContinuousRead(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,int src,unsigned char * dataBuffer,int sizeToRead)
methods.description: Performs a continuous stream read from the DataFlash starting at a specific address.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_MainMemoryToBufferTransfer(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char BufferCommand,unsigned int page)
methods.description: Transfers a page from main memory to SRAM buffer (buffer 1 or 2).

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashWriteBuffer(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char BufferCommand,unsigned char * dataBuffer,unsigned int bufferAddress,int SizeToWrite)
methods.description: Writes data to the internal SRAM buffer 1 or 2 of the DataFlash.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_PageErase(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned int page)
methods.description: Erases a specific page in the DataFlash memory.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_WriteBufferToMain(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char BufferCommand,unsigned int dest)
methods.description: Programs the contents of SRAM buffer into main memory at specified address.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_PartialPageWrite(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char * src,unsigned int dest,unsigned int size)
methods.description: Performs a partial write to a page: reads the page into buffer, modifies, erases, then rewrites.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashWrite(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char * src,int dest,int size)
methods.description: Handles writing arbitrary data across multiple pages into DataFlash memory.

methods.name: int AT91F_DataFlashRead(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned long addr,unsigned long size,char * buffer)
methods.description: Reads data from DataFlash memory starting at a specific address.

methods.name: int AT91F_DataflashProbe(int cs,AT91PS_DataflashDesc pDesc)
methods.description: Checks presence and retrieves status of a DataFlash device on a specified chip select.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashErase(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash)
methods.description: Erases all pages of the DataFlash memory.
